e.title: **「这批数据卖点不是量，而是出处」**：Zenodo 上的美国房贷常量表 **US Mortgage Financing Constants**（DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22676275`）——**四张表、三十行**，**每一行都写明**发布机构、生效年份、**来源网址**与一个「能否被取消」的布尔位**；**⭐ 它逐字说明为什么要这样做**（**逐字**「**The point of the collection is provenance rather than volume.**」）**；**⭐ 并逐字写明它**故意不收**什么**（**房主保险费因逐家而异，**故排除**）
e.title_en: The selling point of this collection is provenance rather than volume: the US Mortgage Financing Constants tables on Zenodo, under a DOI, hold four tables and thirty rows, and every row names the agency that published it, the year it takes effect, the source URL and a boolean for whether the value can be cancelled; the description states verbatim why that matters, that figures of this kind are widely republished without a date or a source which makes them impossible to check and dangerous to reuse once they change, and it states verbatim what it deliberately excludes, namely homeowners insurance premiums because they vary by carrier.
e.title_hk: **「這批資料賣點不是量，而是出處」**：Zenodo 上的美國房貸常量表 **US Mortgage Financing Constants**（DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22676275`）——**四張表、三十行**，**每一行都寫明**發布機構、生效年份、**來源網址**與一個「能否被取消」的布林位**；**⭐ 它逐字說明為什麼要這樣做**（**逐字**「**The point of the collection is provenance rather than volume.**」）**；**⭐ 並逐字寫明它**故意不收**什麼**（**房主保險費因逐家而異，**故排除**）
e.summary: **US Mortgage Financing Constants**（Zenodo 记录 `22676275`，**DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22676275`，**概念 DOI 为** `10.5281/zenodo.22676274`）**是一组美国房贷成本常量表**：**四张表、三十行**，**逐字自述覆盖**「**conforming loan limits**」（**FHFA**）、「**FHA loan limits and premiums**」（**HUD**）、「**mortgage insurance assumptions**」（**PMI／FHA MIP／VA funding fee／USDA guarantee fee**）、**以及**「**ownership cost and qualifying assumptions**」（**CFPB**）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「存证」**，**它是四条里把**出处**写成表结构的一条**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每个值自带来源**——**本次实测** `mortgage-insurance.csv` 的表头逐字为** `"program","key","description","value","unit","cancels","as_of","source","source_url"`，**即**每一行**都带**发布机构、**来源网址、**生效年份（`as_of`）**与一个**能否被取消**的布尔位（`cancels`**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字说明为什么这样做**——**「**The point of the collection is provenance rather than volume. Figures of this kind are widely republished without a date or a source, which makes them impossible to check and dangerous to reuse once they change. Every value here states which agency published it and which year it applies to, so a reader can verify the arithmetic instead of trusting it.**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一句**；**⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字写明**故意排除**了什么**——**「**Homeowners insurance premiums are deliberately excluded: they vary by carrier, construction, claims history and coverage level**」**，**并逐字交代另一处限制**（**PMI 费率为**representative**而非报价**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 登记层面**：**版本** `1.1.0`、**许可** CC-BY-4.0、**创建 2026-09-09**、**8 个文件**（**CSV 与 JSON 各一套**）、**两个 `isDocumentedBy` 链接指向方法与数据集页**。**⚠️ 本次未核对任何一行数字与其所列来源是否一致**（**未访问 FHFA／HUD／VA／CFPB 任何页面**）**。
e.summary_hk: **US Mortgage Financing Constants**（Zenodo 記錄 `22676275`，**DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.22676275`）**是一組美國房貸成本常量表**：**四張表、三十行**，**逐字自述覆蓋** conforming loan limits（FHFA）、FHA loan limits and premiums（HUD）、mortgage insurance assumptions（PMI／FHA MIP／VA funding fee／USDA guarantee fee）**與** ownership cost and qualifying assumptions（CFPB）**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「存證」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每個值自帶來源**——**本次實測** `mortgage-insurance.csv` 表頭逐字為** `"program","key","description","value","unit","cancels","as_of","source","source_url"`**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字說明為什麼**——**「**The point of the collection is provenance rather than volume. Figures of this kind are widely republished without a date or a source, which makes them impossible to check and dangerous to reuse once they change.**」**；**⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字寫明**故意排除**什麼**（**房主保險費**）；**⭐⭐ ④ 登記層面**：**版本 1.1.0、**許可 CC-BY-4.0、**創建 2026-09-09、**8 個檔案**、**兩個 `isDocumentedBy` 連結**。**⚠️ 本次未核對任何一行數字與其來源是否一致**。
e.summary_en: The Zenodo record for US Mortgage Financing Constants, under a version DOI and a concept DOI, **holds reference tables of the constants that determine what a US mortgage costs**: four tables and thirty rows covering conforming loan limits from the housing finance agency, FHA limits and premiums from the housing department, mortgage insurance assumptions including private mortgage insurance, FHA premiums, VA funding fees and USDA guarantee fees, and ownership cost and qualifying assumptions from the consumer financial protection bureau. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and of the four it is the one that writes provenance into the table structure**: the measured header of its mortgage insurance file carries programme, key, description, value, unit, a cancellation flag, an as-of year, a source name and a source URL, so **every single row names the agency that published it, the year it applies to and where to check it, plus whether the value can be cancelled**. **The description states the purpose verbatim**: the point of the collection is provenance rather than volume, since figures of this kind are widely republished without a date or a source, which makes them impossible to check and dangerous to reuse once they change, and every value here states which agency published it and which year it applies to so a reader can verify the arithmetic instead of trusting it. **It also states verbatim what it deliberately leaves out**, namely homeowners insurance premiums, because they vary by carrier, construction and claims, and it flags that private mortgage insurance rates are representative rather than quoted. **Registration details measured**: version 1.1.0, licence CC-BY-4.0, created 2026-09-09, eight files supplied as both CSV and JSON, and two documented-by links pointing at a methodology page. **No row was checked against the agency it cites, and no agency page was visited.**
e.body:
**US Mortgage Financing Constants: Loan Limits, Insurance Premiums and Underwriting Assumptions (2026)**（Zenodo 记录 `22676275`）**是一组美国房贷成本常量表**，**本次实测**：**DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22676275`**、概念 DOI 为** `10.5281/zenodo.22676274`**、**版本** `1.1.0`**、**类型** Dataset**、**许可** CC-BY-4.0**、**创建与更新均为 2026-09-09**、**访问权限为** open**、**共 8 个文件**（**四张表各有 CSV 与 JSON 两种形式**）**；**作者** `Mane, Chetan`（**逐字附 ORCID** `0009-0001-8032-6101`）**；**关键字逐字含** `conforming loan limit`、`FHA loan limits`、`mortgage insurance premium`、`private mortgage insurance`、`VA funding fee`、`debt-to-income ratio`、`mortgage underwriting`、`United States`**；**关联标识两个**，**逐字为** `https://www.usmortgagecalc.com/datasets` **与** `.../methodology`，**关系均为** `isDocumentedBy`**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**存证：编号、版本、许可，以及把每个数追回它的来源**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo 元数据与文件实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 表结构本身就是出处声明**——**本次实读** `mortgage-insurance.csv`，**表头逐字为** `"program","key","description","value","unit","cancels","as_of","source","source_url"`**；**每一行实测形如**：`conventional` / `pmi_annual_percent` / **说明逐字为**「**Private mortgage insurance, percent of the original loan amount per year**」/ `0.6` / `percent` / `cancels` 为 `true` / `as_of` 为 `2025` / **来源** `Consumer Financial Protection Bureau` / **来源网址** `https://www.consumerfinance.gov/`；**另有** FHA 的 `fha_upfront_mip_percent`（`1.75`**，**来源 HUD**）**、**`fha_annual_mip_percent`（`0.55`**，**说明逐字含**「**Lasts the life of the loan below a 10% down payment**」**）**、**VA 的 `va_funding_fee_first_use_zero_down`（`2.15`**，**说明逐字含**「**Replaces monthly mortgage insurance**」**）**。**⭐ 即**「**这个数是谁发的、**哪一年生效、**能在哪一页核对、**以及它会不会被取消**」**四件事**被放在同一行里**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**。`conforming-loan-limits.csv` **表头逐字为** `"limit_type","description","amount_usd","as_of","source","source_url","changes_annually"`**，**实测一行逐字为** `baseline_conforming` / **说明**「**Baseline conforming loan limit for a one-unit property in most counties**」/ `806500` / `2025` / **FHFA** / `https://www.fhfa.gov/` / **`changes_annually` 为 `true`**——**⭐ 即**它还标注了**这个数会不会每年变**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字说明为什么这批数据的重点是出处**——**Zenodo 描述逐字**：**「**Four reference tables covering the constants that determine what a US mortgage costs, each figure published with a named source and the year it takes effect.**」**，**随后**：**「**The point of the collection is provenance rather than volume. Figures of this kind are widely republished without a date or a source, which makes them impossible to check and dangerous to reuse once they change. Every value here states which agency published it and which year it applies to, so a reader can verify the arithmetic instead of trusting it.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它把**「**这类数字被广泛转贴时不带日期与来源**」**点名为一个**具体危害**（**无法核对、且一旦变化就危险**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它给出的解法不是「我们更权威」，而是**「**让读者能自己核对**」（**verify the arithmetic instead of trusting it**）；**③ ⭐⭐ 它把**数据的时间点**写清**（**逐字**「**Data as of 2025 programme year; last reviewed August 2026.**」**）**——**⭐ 即**「**数据是哪一年的**」与「**我什么时候复核过**」**是两件事、两句话**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字写明**故意不收**什么，以及另一处限制**——**逐字**：**「**Limitations: conventional PMI rates are representative rather than quoted — actual pricing varies by insurer, credit score and loan-to-value. Homeowners insurance premiums are deliberately excluded: they vary by carrier, construction, claims history and coverage level**」**。**⭐ 即**它区分了**两种「不确定」**：**一种是**我这行数只是代表值**（**仍给一个数并标明性质**），**另一种是**这个量根本不该被列成单值**（**因逐家而异，**故整类不收**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这个区分很值得抄**：**不确切的仍然列出并标明，**而本质上无法统一的**直接排除并说明理由**。**⭐⭐ ④ 交付形式是可核对的两种**——**8 个文件**：`ownership-cost-assumptions.csv`／`.json`、`mortgage-insurance.csv`／`.json`、`conforming-loan-limits.csv`／`.json`、`fha-limits.csv`／`.json`；**描述逐字**「**Thirty rows across four tables, supplied as CSV (RFC 4180) and JSON.**」**——**⭐ 即**它连 CSV 遵循的规范（**RFC 4180**）都写出来了**；**⭐ 本词条如实标注**：**JSON 那四份本次**未打开**（**只读了两份 CSV**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 登记机制值得记录**：**该记录有**概念 DOI**（`10.5281/zenodo.22676274`）与**版本 DOI**（`10.5281/zenodo.22676275`）**两层**，**故**引用时可以选「**永久指向这个概念**」或「**指向这一版**」；**⭐ 并与本站池内已有的**8 条 Zenodo 来源条目**同一形态**（**如 [[inflation-aware-xol-reserving]]、[[claims-inflation-motor-my]]、[[scelo]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fanniemae-underwriting-rules]] 记录的是**房贷承保规则的代码化**，**[[tpa-transparency-data]]、[[cms-open-data]] 记录的是**监管与公开数据源**，**而本条补上的是**「**把一批散落在不同机构的常量**逐行标注出处**之后放进一个带 DOI 的表里**」这一做法**——**⭐ 其领域（**美国房贷与房贷保险**）与我们的精算主线相邻但不同**（**本词条如实指出这一点**）**，**故本条的价值主要在**出处写法**而不在题材**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[fanniemae-underwriting-rules]]、[[tpa-transparency-data]] 应当并读**——**它给的是一个**可以直接照抄的表设计**：**把「**发布机构、**来源网址、**生效年份、**是否会定期变、**是否可取消**」**作为列**，**而不是写进附注**；**⭐ 对本词条项目自身**，**它那句「**provenance rather than volume**」**与本站**「**每个数都要能回到来源**」**是同一条纪律的另一种说法**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有核对任何一行数字与其所列来源是否一致**（**未访问** FHFA、HUD、VA、CFPB **或** usmortgagecalc.com **的任何页面**）**，**故不主张**任何常量的数值、`as_of` 年份或来源归属正确**——**本词条只主张「**表里写了这些列、这些行**」**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读 JSON 四份**（**只读了两份 CSV 的表头与若干行**），**故不主张 JSON 的结构与 CSV 是否一一对应**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 30 行**这个数的构成**（**描述逐字称三十行**，**而本次**只逐行读了其中两份文件的若干行，**未逐行计数四张表**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份**（**只读到姓名与一个 ORCID**）**与** usmortgagecalc.com **的性质**（**未访问该站**）**；**⚠️ Zenodo 的下载量与引用数本次未记录**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实许可适用范围**：**记录字段为** CC-BY-4.0**，**本次**未读任何附带的许可说明文件**（**该记录只有 8 个数据文件，**本次未见独立许可文本**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 该记录**创建 2026-09-09 在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**把监管常量逐行标注机构与生效年份、并明确排除无法统一列值的那一类**」这一形态，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**本条的领域是**美国住房金融**，**与本站以**保险与精算**为主线的定位**相邻而不重合****。
e.body_hk:
**US Mortgage Financing Constants: Loan Limits, Insurance Premiums and Underwriting Assumptions (2026)**（Zenodo 記錄 `22676275`）**是一組美國房貸成本常量表**。**本次實測**：**DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.22676275`**、概念 DOI 為** `10.5281/zenodo.22676274`**、**版本** `1.1.0`**、**類型** Dataset**、**許可** CC-BY-4.0**、**建立與更新均為 2026-09-09**、**共 8 個檔案**（**四張表各有 CSV 與 JSON**）**；**作者** `Mane, Chetan`（**附 ORCID**）**；**關鍵字逐字含** `mortgage insurance premium`、`private mortgage insurance`、`VA funding fee`、`debt-to-income ratio`**；**關聯標識兩個**，**關係均為** `isDocumentedBy`**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**存證：編號、版本、許可，以及把每個數追回它的來源**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Zenodo 元數據與檔案實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 表結構本身就是出處聲明**——**實讀** `mortgage-insurance.csv`，**表頭逐字為** `"program","key","description","value","unit","cancels","as_of","source","source_url"`**；**每一行實測形如**：`conventional` / `pmi_annual_percent` / `0.6` / `percent` / `cancels` **為** `true` / `as_of` **為** `2025` / **來源** `Consumer Financial Protection Bureau` / **來源網址** `https://www.consumerfinance.gov/`；**另有** FHA `fha_upfront_mip_percent`（`1.75`，HUD）、`fha_annual_mip_percent`（`0.55`，**說明逐字含**「**Lasts the life of the loan below a 10% down payment**」）、VA `va_funding_fee_first_use_zero_down`（`2.15`）。**⭐ 即**「**這個數是誰發的、**哪一年生效、**能在哪一頁核對、**以及它會不會被取消**」**四件事**放在同一行**。`conforming-loan-limits.csv` **表頭逐字為** `"limit_type","description","amount_usd","as_of","source","source_url","changes_annually"`，**實測一行** `baseline_conforming`／`806500`／`2025`／FHFA／`https://www.fhfa.gov/`／**`changes_annually` 為 `true`**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字說明為什麼重點是出處**——**逐字**：**「**The point of the collection is provenance rather than volume. Figures of this kind are widely republished without a date or a source, which makes them impossible to check and dangerous to reuse once they change. Every value here states which agency published it and which year it applies to, so a reader can verify the arithmetic instead of trusting it.**」**。**⭐ 三處值得記**：**① 它把「**這類數字被廣泛轉貼時不帶日期與來源**」**點名為具體危害**；**② 它給的解法不是「我們更權威」，而是**「讓讀者能自己核對」**；**③ 它把數據時間點與複核時間分成兩句話**（**逐字**「**Data as of 2025 programme year; last reviewed August 2026.**」**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字寫明**故意不收**什麼**——**逐字**：**「**conventional PMI rates are representative rather than quoted — actual pricing varies by insurer, credit score and loan-to-value. Homeowners insurance premiums are deliberately excluded: they vary by carrier, construction, claims history and coverage level**」**——**⭐ 即**它區分了**「**只是代表值**」（**仍列出並標明**）與「**本質上無法列單值**」（**整類不收並說明理由**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 交付形式是可核對的兩種**——**8 個檔案**（**CSV 與 JSON 各四**）**；**描述逐字**「**Thirty rows across four tables, supplied as CSV (RFC 4180) and JSON.**」**；**⭐ 本詞條如實標註**：**JSON 四份本次未打開**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 登記機制**：**該記錄有**概念 DOI**與**版本 DOI**兩層**；**⭐ 與池內已有的 8 條 Zenodo 來源條目同一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[fanniemae-underwriting-rules]]、[[tpa-transparency-data]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是一個可直接照抄的表設計**：**把「**發布機構、**來源網址、**生效年份、**是否定期變、**是否可取消**」**作為欄位**；**⭐ 它那句「**provenance rather than volume**」與本站「**每個數都要能回到來源**」是同一條紀律**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有核對任何一行數字與其來源是否一致**（**未訪問** FHFA／HUD／VA／CFPB 或 usmortgagecalc.com**），**故不主張**任何常量數值、`as_of` 年份或來源歸屬正確**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀 JSON 四份**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實「**三十行**」的構成**（**未逐行計數四張表**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份與** usmortgagecalc.com **的性質**；**未記錄下載量與引用數**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實許可適用範圍**（**未見獨立許可文本**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 建立 2026-09-09 在解凍窗口之內**，**故本條不需要窗口例外**；**但「把監管常量逐行標註機構與生效年份、並明確排除無法統一列值的那一類」此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⭐ 並如實指出本條領域為**美國住房金融**，**與本站以**保險與精算**為主線的定位**相鄰而不重合****。
e.body_en:
The Zenodo record for US Mortgage Financing Constants, published in 2026, **is a set of reference tables for the constants that determine what a US mortgage costs**. **Measured this round**: a version DOI and a concept DOI, **version 1.1.0**, resource type Dataset, **licence CC-BY-4.0**, **created and updated on 2026-09-09**, open access, **eight files** in total, meaning each of four tables is supplied in both CSV and JSON; the creator carries an ORCID; the keywords name conforming loan limits, FHA loan limits, mortgage insurance premiums, private mortgage insurance, VA funding fees, debt-to-income ratios and mortgage underwriting; and two related identifiers, both marked as documented by, point at a datasets page and a methodology page. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability: a number, a version, a licence, and tracing every value back to its source.**

**Verified information, all measured from the Zenodo metadata and the files themselves**: **first, the table structure is itself a provenance claim.** The measured header of the mortgage insurance file carries columns for programme, key, description, value, unit, a cancellation flag, an as-of year, a source name and a source URL. **Measured rows read as follows**: conventional private mortgage insurance at six tenths of a percent per year, cancellable, as of 2025, sourced to the consumer financial protection bureau with its URL; FHA upfront premium at 1.75 percent and annual premium at 0.55 percent sourced to the housing department, the latter annotated verbatim as lasting the life of the loan below a ten percent down payment; and a VA funding fee of 2.15 percent for first use with no down payment, annotated verbatim as replacing monthly mortgage insurance. **Four facts therefore sit on the same row: who issued the number, which year it takes effect, where it can be checked, and whether it can be cancelled.** The loan limits file adds columns for amount, as-of year, source and whether the value changes annually, with a measured row giving 806,500 dollars as the baseline conforming limit for a one-unit property in most counties as of 2025, sourced to the federal housing finance agency, and flagged as changing annually. **Second, the description states why the point of the collection is provenance.** Verbatim, these are four reference tables covering the constants that determine what a US mortgage costs, each figure published with a named source and the year it takes effect; the point of the collection is provenance rather than volume, because figures of this kind are widely republished without a date or a source, which makes them impossible to check and dangerous to reuse once they change; and every value here states which agency published it and which year it applies to, so a reader can verify the arithmetic instead of trusting it. **Three things are worth recording**: it names a concrete harm, that such figures circulate undated and unsourced; its remedy is not a claim of greater authority but making verification possible for the reader; and it separates two statements in two sentences, that the data is as of a given programme year and that it was last reviewed in a given month. **Third, it states verbatim what it deliberately leaves out and where else it is limited**, noting that conventional private mortgage insurance rates are representative rather than quoted because actual pricing varies by insurer, credit score and loan-to-value, and that homeowners insurance premiums are deliberately excluded because they vary by carrier, construction and claims. **It therefore distinguishes two kinds of uncertainty: a value that is merely representative, which is still listed with its character stated, and a quantity that cannot be stated as a single value at all, which is excluded as a class with the reason given.** **Fourth, delivery is two machine-readable forms**: eight files, four tables each in CSV and JSON, with the description stating verbatim that thirty rows across four tables are supplied as CSV following RFC 4180 and as JSON. **The JSON files were not opened this round. Fifth, the registration mechanism is worth recording**: the record carries both a concept DOI and a version DOI, so a citation can point either at the idea or at this particular version, **which matches the shape of the eight Zenodo-sourced entries already in the pool. Sixth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled mortgage underwriting rules entry records the codification of underwriting rules and the pooled transparency and open data entries record regulator-side sources, while this entry supplies the practice of taking constants scattered across agencies, annotating each row with its source, and publishing them as a DOI-bearing table. **This entry states plainly that the subject matter is US housing finance, adjacent to but not overlapping the insurance and actuarial focus of this wiki, so its value here lies in the sourcing practice rather than the topic.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[fanniemae-underwriting-rules]] and [[tpa-transparency-data]]**, because **it is a table design that can be copied directly**: make the issuing agency, the source URL, the effective year, whether it changes periodically and whether it can be cancelled into columns rather than footnotes; **and its phrase about provenance rather than volume is another way of stating this wiki own rule that every number must trace back to a source**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no row was checked against the source it cites and no agency page was visited** — neither the housing finance agency, the housing department, the veterans affairs department, the consumer financial protection bureau nor the site named as documentation — **so no constant value, as-of year or source attribution is claimed correct; this entry claims only that the table contains these columns and these rows. This is the item most in need of later verification.** **Second, the four JSON files were not read**, so nothing is claimed about their structure or whether they correspond one-to-one with the CSVs. **Third, the composition of the claimed thirty rows was not verified**, only several rows of two files were read and the four tables were not counted row by row. **Fourth, the creator identity and the nature of the site named as documentation were not verified**, only a name and an ORCID were read, and download and citation counts were not recorded. **Fifth, the scope of the licence was not verified**: the metadata field reads CC-BY-4.0 and no separate licence text was seen among the eight data files. **Sixth, the record was created on 2026-09-09, inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the shape of annotating regulatory constants row by row with their issuing agency and effective year, and of explicitly excluding a class of quantities that cannot be stated as single values, had no counterpart in the pool. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that its subject matter is US housing finance, adjacent to but not overlapping this wiki main focus.**

Every value here states which agency published it and which year it applies to, so a reader can verify the arithmetic instead of trusting it.」、「Thirty rows across four tables, supplied as CSV (RFC 4180) and JSON.」、「Data as of 2025 programme year; last reviewed August 2026.」以及 Limitations（PMI 为 representative 而非报价；房主保险费 deliberately excluded）｜⚠️未核对任何一行数字与其所列来源是否一致（未访问 FHFA／HUD／VA／CFPB／usmortgagecalc.com 任何页面），不主张任何数值、as_of 年份或来源归属正确——本条目最需后续核实的一处｜⚠️未读四份 JSON（只读两份 CSV 的表头与若干行），不主张 JSON 结构与 CSV 一一对应｜⚠️未逐行计数四张表，未核实「三十行」的构成｜⚠️未核实作者身份与该站性质，未记录下载量与引用数｜⚠️未读独立许可文本，只记录元数据字段为 CC-BY-4.0｜⚠️创建 2026-09-09 在解冻窗口之内，无需窗口例外；但「监管常量逐行标注机构与生效年份＋明确排除无法统一列值的那一类」此前池内无对应物｜⚠️本条的领域为美国住房金融，与本站以保险与精算为主线的定位相邻而不重合，本词条如实指出｜⚠️本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见
